problem_text:
A logistics coordinator needs to assign packages to identical delivery trucks. Packages:
* Package Alpha: size 63 units
* Package Beta: size 52 units
* Package Gamma: size 42 units
* Package Delta: size 45 units
* Package Epsilon: size 39 units
* Package Zeta: size 44 units
* Package Eta: size 49 units
* Package Theta: size 39 units
* Package Iota: size 41 units
* Package Kappa: size 65 units
* Package Lambda: size 46 units
* Package Mu: size 64 units
* Package Nu: size 31 units
* Package Xi: size 41 units
* Package Omicron: size 44 units
* Package Pi: size 56 units
* Package Rho: size 40 units
* Package Sigma: size 45 units
* Package Tau: size 65 units
* Package Upsilon: size 38 units
* Package Phi: size 67 units
* Package Chi: size 40 units
* Package Psi: size 45 units
* Package Omega: size 63 units

Each truck has a maximum capacity of 100 units. Assign all packages using the minimum number of trucks. Every package must be loaded onto exactly one truck, and the total size of packages in any truck cannot exceed its capacity limit.
